x8nmvj.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of turning right for via Gemona at the first junction
x8nmvj.why: The right arrow at the first junction is linked to via Gemona.

18rqdn6.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of turning right for the city centre at the second junction
18rqdn6.why: The right arrow at the second junction is linked to the word centro.

1ma4uqb.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of turning right towards Trieste at the second junction
1ma4uqb.why: At the second junction you turn right for Trieste, shown by the blue panel on the right.

mc197p.q: The sign shown indicates that you must turn left at the second junction to reach Austria
mc197p.why: At the second junction you turn left for Austria, Tarvisio and Tolmezzo, as shown by the left blue panel.

1s7tdi6.q: The sign shown indicates two nearby junctions on an urban road
1s7tdi6.why: The white background indicates an urban road, and the diagram shows two nearby junctions.

1w5kmwx.q: The sign shown is found on extra-urban roads
1w5kmwx.why: A white background is used for urban signs; on extra-urban roads the background is blue.

n15f66.q: The sign shown indicates how to leave vehicles parked
n15f66.why: The sign gives advance directions at junctions and has nothing to do with parking.

6xcbrh.q: The sign shown tells vehicles heading to Austria to turn back
6xcbrh.why: For Austria you turn left at the second junction; you do not turn back.

n21ypn.q: The sign shown allows turning left at the first junction
n21ypn.why: At the first junction a no-entry sign blocks the left turn, so it is not allowed.

1d4iyxk.q: The sign shown indicates how to leave a shopping centre
1d4iyxk.why: The sign is an advance warning of two urban junctions, not an exit from a shopping centre.

1qejv2e.q: The sign shown announces the directions for entering the motorway
1qejv2e.why: The sign shows destinations such as Austria and Trieste, not a motorway entrance, which would use green panels.

f0qm63.q: The sign shown is an advance warning of an urban junction with a roundabout
f0qm63.why: The diagram shows a roundabout (rotatoria) with its exits: it is an advance warning of an urban junction with a roundabout.

1s5lto9.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of taking the first turning on the right to go to Forlì
1s5lto9.why: Forlì is shown on the right of the roundabout, at the first exit.

6tzmyr.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of taking the second turning to reach the ring road
6tzmyr.why: The ring road (tangenziale), with motorways A1 and A13, is shown at the second exit.

1wxiyx8.q: The sign shown contains the layout of the roundabout
1wxiyx8.why: The graphic layout of the roundabout is at the centre of the sign.

192eemo.q: The sign shown lists the names of the places that can be reached
192eemo.why: The sign lists the names of reachable places, such as Forlì, Bologna and tangenziale.

cmvhzf.q: The sign shown indicates a road closed
cmvhzf.why: The sign shows directions at a roundabout, not a closed road.

ztp0y4.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a pedestrian area with public greenery
ztp0y4.why: The sign gives advance warning of roundabout exits, not a pedestrian area.

mdvxi0.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a ban on vehicle traffic
mdvxi0.why: This is an information sign and gives no warning of any traffic ban.

1n1wtq8.q: The sign shown is found on extra-urban roads
1n1wtq8.why: The white background is typical of urban signs; on extra-urban roads signs are blue.

q90fuo.q: The sign shown applies only at night
q90fuo.why: An information sign applies at all times, not only at night.

1t0k4jv.q: The sign shown is an advance warning of an urban junction
1t0k4jv.why: The white background with arrows and destinations is an advance warning of an urban junction.

13wgxl3.q: The sign shown prohibits lorries with a full-load mass over 3.5 tonnes from continuing straight to Avezzano
13wgxl3.why: The lorry prohibition symbol on the straight arrow bans goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes in full-load mass from going straight to Avezzano.

1y0e59t.q: The sign shown allows cars to continue straight to Pescara
1y0e59t.why: The ban concerns only goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes; cars may continue straight.

10ft2qb.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of turning left to reach the Roma-L'Aquila motorway
10ft2qb.why: The left arrow leads to the green panel for the A24 Roma-L'Aquila motorway.

11s0mmf.q: The sign shown prohibits lorries with a full-load mass over 3.5 tonnes from continuing straight to reach the town centre
11s0mmf.why: The ban on the straight arrow applies to goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes heading for the town centre.

g6ya6y.q: The sign shown also prohibits buses from reaching Avezzano
g6ya6y.why: The symbol shows only goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes; buses are not covered by the ban.

ljvhxj.q: The sign shown is found only on one-way roads
ljvhxj.why: The advance direction sign is not limited to one-way roads; it may appear on urban roads in general.

16lp9we.q: The sign shown is located at the entrance to a motorway
16lp9we.why: This is a white-background urban lane-selection sign, not a motorway one. Motorway entrances use green signs.

1cdiehk.q: The sign shown indicates that the central lane is closed
1cdiehk.why: The arrows show where each lane leads (straight for Pescara and Avezzano, left for Roma-L'Aquila). No lane is closed; the symbol only shows a ban on heavy goods vehicles.

1l3zeft.q: The sign shown is one of the priority signs
1l3zeft.why: It is an information sign (lane preselection) that shows directions. Priority signs are different ones, such as STOP and give way.

1wn6sab.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a junction on an extra-urban road
1wn6sab.why: The blue background marks an extra-urban road, and the arrows show the directions available at the junction ahead (advance junction sign).

1t6xtim.q: The sign shown indicates a level crossing when turning right
1t6xtim.why: The level crossing symbol sits on the right-hand arrow, so the road you take by turning right has a level crossing (passaggio a livello).

1uornj5.q: The sign shown gives advance notice to continue straight ahead to reach Porto Torres
1uornj5.why: The straight arrow leads to Porto Torres, the name shown at the top, so you continue straight ahead.

w7w7qs.q: The sign shown gives advance notice to turn left for a tourist location
w7w7qs.why: The brown panel (nuraghe Speranza) marks a tourist destination, reached by the left-hand arrow.

1plqrou.q: The sign shown gives advance notice to turn right for S. Giovanni
1plqrou.why: The diagonal right arrow leads to S. Giovanni.

3dzwye.q: The sign shown warns of a hazard for those turning right, due to possible train crossings
3dzwye.why: The level crossing symbol is on the right arrow, so drivers turning right will meet a railway crossing where trains pass.

qsmaom.q: The sign shown is located after a junction
qsmaom.why: It is an advance sign, placed before the junction to inform drivers of the directions ahead.

1ye2lfc.q: The sign shown indicates a seaside resort on the left
1ye2lfc.why: The brown panel on the left reads nuraghe Speranza, an archaeological site, not a seaside resort.

1lwh1jq.q: The sign shown is one of the mandatory signs
1lwh1jq.why: It is an information sign (advance junction sign) and imposes no obligation. Mandatory signs are the round blue ones.

956v8q.q: The sign shown indicates that it is not possible to reach S. Giovanni
956v8q.why: S. Giovanni can be reached by turning right, as the diagonal arrow shows.

13iirvh.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of an urban junction with a residential area on the left
13iirvh.why: The blue background means an extra-urban road, not an urban one. On the left the brown panel marks a tourist site, not a residential area.

187i7xh.q: The sign shown is placed on extra-urban roads divided into two lanes
187i7xh.why: The blue background means an extra-urban road, and the dashed line separates the two lanes, each with its own destination.

185deic.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a preselection zone with two destinations
185deic.why: The sign assigns lanes to two destinations: Bari on the left and Pescara straight ahead (preselection, presegnalamento).

7rah8k.q: The sign shown tells drivers heading to Bari to move into the left lane
7rah8k.why: Bari is on the left side with a left arrow, so drivers going there must move into the left lane.

1vljha9.q: The sign shown tells drivers heading to Pescara to move into the right lane
1vljha9.why: Pescara is on the right side with a straight arrow, so drivers going there must use the right lane.

7wsxg6.q: The sign shown is placed where it is still possible to change the channelling lane
7wsxg6.why: The centre line is dashed, so changing lanes is still allowed; the lanes are not yet fixed (corsie di canalizzazione).

16dzgmh.q: The sign shown indicates an obligation to overtake on the right
16dzgmh.why: It is an information sign showing destinations by lane. It imposes no obligation to overtake.

ptt20t.q: The sign shown indicates that the road to Bari is closed
ptt20t.why: The left arrow shows the direction to follow for Bari, so the road is open.

29al4s.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a long straight stretch on the right
29al4s.why: The sign does not describe the road layout; it shows the destinations reached from each lane.

nw8hvj.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a dangerous bend on the left
nw8hvj.why: It is not a warning sign. The left arrow shows the direction to Bari, not a bend.

vh1ypu.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an obligation to reverse direction
vh1ypu.why: The sign informs about the directions to Bari and Pescara and does not require any U-turn.

7m0tfv.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an overpass on the left
7m0tfv.why: The sign does not show an overpass; the left arrow shows the lane for Bari.

1qzaz80.q: The sign shown is placed on urban roads
1qzaz80.why: The white background is typical of urban direction signs.

12d00z6.q: The sign shown, on multi-lane urban roads, allows entering the channelling lanes
12d00z6.why: The dashed lines let you move into the right lane for your destination before the lanes become fixed (corsie di canalizzazione).

cmgh5t.q: The sign shown tells drivers heading to the tourist location to move into the middle lane
cmgh5t.why: The brown Terminillo panel (tourist location) is in the middle lane with a straight arrow.

1ibcrj0.q: The sign shown tells drivers heading to Terni to move into the left lane
1ibcrj0.why: Terni appears above the left lane, with a left arrow.

1nxpmad.q: The sign shown tells drivers heading to the city centre to take the right lane
1nxpmad.why: The word centro with the city-centre symbol is on the right lane, with a right arrow.

13aerna.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a motorway junction
13aerna.why: The white background shows an urban road. Motorway junctions use green-background signs.

19zaev3.q: The sign shown indicates how to reach a car park
19zaev3.why: The sign shows no car park. It lists Terni, Salaria/Terminillo, viale Maraini, the centre and via Cintia.

h7jsem.q: The sign shown indicates that Terni is 500 metres after making the turn
h7jsem.why: No distance appears on the sign; it only shows which lane to use for each destination.

j87cpy.q: The sign shown indicates that, in the side lanes, drivers must reverse direction
j87cpy.why: The side arrows show left and right turns, not U-turns.

xxw34m.q: The sign shown indicates that the road to Terni is closed
xxw34m.why: The left arrow under Terni shows the lane leading there, so the road is open.

tfumvh.q: The sign shown indicates that it is no longer possible to change lane
tfumvh.why: The dashed lines show that changing lane is still possible.

2ysp0c.q: The sign shown indicates the entrance to a hospital
2ysp0c.why: The bed and red cross symbol means hospital (ospedale), and the arrow shows the direction to reach it.

oqpxaj.q: The sign shown, which indicates the proximity of a hospital, asks drivers not to make disturbing noise nearby
oqpxaj.why: Near hospitals you must avoid disturbing noise and needless use of the horn.

okhdv.q: The sign shown indicates the direction to enter the hospital
okhdv.why: The left arrow shows which way to go to reach the hospital.

f08nds.q: The sign shown is placed at a hospital
f08nds.why: The sign is placed near a hospital to show its presence and direction.

1uixbb0.q: The sign shown indicates the proximity of a hotel
1uixbb0.why: The bed with a red cross means hospital. A hotel has a different symbol, without the cross.

dxmc3e.q: The sign shown indicates the proximity of a railway station with sleeping cars
dxmc3e.why: The red cross symbol means a hospital, not a railway station.

mbxkpy.q: The sign shown indicates a car park reserved for doctors
mbxkpy.why: It does not show a car park; the bed with a red cross marks a hospital.

1ei08ot.q: The sign shown indicates a public dormitory
1ei08ot.why: The red cross distinguishes a hospital from a public dormitory, which uses a different symbol.

5gyf64.q: The sign shown indicates that to reach Bologna you must continue straight ahead
5gyf64.why: The straight arrow goes with Bologna (A1), so you continue straight ahead to reach it.

1lzi9m6.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of two specific destinations
1lzi9m6.why: The sign shows two destinations: Bologna (A1) straight ahead and Linate to the left.

1805x2o.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an interchange with a left turn to Linate airport
1805x2o.why: The aeroplane symbol and the word Linate with a left arrow show the turn for the airport.

1xfj3av.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a motorway interchange
1xfj3av.why: The green background means motorway (autostrada); this is an advance interchange sign.

1ldyg2l.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an interchange where you must continue straight to go to Bologna
1ldyg2l.why: The straight arrow leads to Bologna, while the left turn leads to Linate.

iqqeh4.q: The sign shown is found on extra-urban roads
iqqeh4.why: The green background is reserved for motorways; other extra-urban roads use blue.

cvhrv1.q: The sign shown prohibits turning left
cvhrv1.why: It is an information sign. The left arrow shows the way to Linate and is not a prohibition.

14tutp.q: The sign shown indicates that Bologna is one kilometre away
14tutp.why: No distance is shown; the sign only shows the directions to follow.

76c0y5.q: The sign shown obliges drivers to change lane to reach Bologna
76c0y5.why: To reach Bologna you simply continue straight; there is no obligation to change lane.

luc8xm.q: The sign shown is placed at the entrance to an airport
luc8xm.why: It is an advance interchange sign placed before the exit, not at the airport entrance.

1ceq9hd.q: The sign shown indicates a playground on the left
1ceq9hd.why: The aeroplane with the word Linate indicates the airport, not a playground.

1ij1fkr.q: The sign shown indicates that to reach Milan you must continue straight ahead
1ij1fkr.why: The straight arrow is associated with Milano.

sceo8c.q: The sign shown indicates two specific destinations
sceo8c.why: The sign shows two destinations: Milano and the city centre (centro).

5geem6.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a junction with a right turn for the town centre
5geem6.why: The right-turning arrow sits next to centro with the city-centre symbol.

8k61ct.q: The sign shown can be found on urban roads
8k61ct.why: The white background is typical of urban direction signs.

1cuxlke.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a junction where you must continue straight to go to Milan
1cuxlke.why: The straight arrow leads to Milano and the right arrow to the centre.

13cd4sy.q: The sign shown is found only on one-way roads
13cd4sy.why: Advance junction signs like this also appear on two-way roads; they are not limited to one-way streets.

1r5wjxc.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a junction for the shooting range
1r5wjxc.why: The sign shows the city centre, not a shooting range.

196bnz9.q: The sign shown indicates that turning right leads to a secondary road
196bnz9.why: Turning right leads to the city centre; the sign says nothing about a secondary road.

1iudvl5.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the end of two-way traffic and the start of a one-way road
1iudvl5.why: It is an advance junction sign and does not signal any change in traffic direction.

1tzmfe4.q: The sign shown tells you to turn right to reach a shopping centre
1tzmfe4.why: The right turn leads to the city centre (target symbol), not a shopping centre.

o1402e.q: The sign shown is found on main extra-urban roads
o1402e.why: The blue background with an exit and the places it serves is typical of main extra-urban roads (strade extraurbane principali).

17hd2ij.q: The sign shown indicates that the Frosinone exit is 500 metres away
17hd2ij.why: The panel at the bottom shows 500 m, the distance to the Frosinone exit.

13ykpj4.q: The sign shown lists the names of the places reachable by leaving the main extra-urban road
13ykpj4.why: The blue panel lists the places reached from the Frosinone exit.

5szme2.q: The sign shown indicates tourist locations through the writing on a brown background
5szme2.why: Circeo and Campocatino are on a brown background, the colour used for tourist destinations.

1h3k73.q: The sign shown indicates the distance between the sign and the next exit
1h3k73.why: The 500 m panel shows how far the exit is from the sign.

1ehk7d5.q: The sign shown is found when leaving the municipality of Frosinone
1ehk7d5.why: The sign announces the Frosinone exit ahead; it is not placed when leaving the town.

1m1ue4m.q: The sign shown indicates that the municipality of Frosinone is reached in 500 metres
1m1ue4m.why: The 500 m is the distance to the exit, not to the town of Frosinone.

1uqaec9.q: The sign shown indicates that all places on the sign are 500 metres away
1uqaec9.why: The 500 m refers only to the exit; the places listed are farther away.

1wsydno.q: The sign shown indicates that the road is no longer passable and that the last exit is Frosinone
1wsydno.why: The sign gives information about the Frosinone exit and does not signal a road closure.

14jm6tm.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a built-up area
14jm6tm.why: The start of a built-up area is shown by a white sign with the name and no red bar (centro abitato).

1188j5m.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the built-up area
1188j5m.why: The name Montecompatri crossed by a red bar marks the end of the built-up area (centro abitato).

b2uj3p.q: The sign shown, in the first line at the top of the blue panel, indicates the next town
b2uj3p.why: The first line of the blue panel names the next town: S. Cesareo.

14c7tat.q: The sign shown indicates the end of the built-up area and the following places
14c7tat.why: The crossed-out name marks the end of the town, and the blue panel lists the places ahead.

9auy6m.q: The sign shown, in the blue panel, indicates the distance in kilometres for each place
9auy6m.why: The number next to each place gives the distance in kilometres.

23cw8k.q: The sign shown indicates that Napoli is 190 kilometres away
23cw8k.why: The number 190 next to Napoli is the distance in kilometres.

oaeaa1.q: The sign shown indicates that S. Cesareo is 7 kilometres away
oaeaa1.why: The number 7 next to S. Cesareo is the distance in kilometres.

rekovi.q: The sign shown indicates the start of an uphill stretch of road to reach Montecompatri
rekovi.why: The sign has nothing to do with gradients; the red bar marks the end of the built-up area of Montecompatri.

1qw4plq.q: The sign shown indicates that it is not possible to reach Montecompatri
1qw4plq.why: It only shows that you are leaving the built-up area of Montecompatri; the road is not closed.

1il3n1t.q: The sign shown indicates that to reach Napoli you must take state road no. 190
1il3n1t.why: The 190 is the distance in kilometres, not the number of a state road (strada statale).

1rqne4g.q: The sign shown indicates a road closed to traffic
1rqne4g.why: The red bar over the name marks the end of the built-up area, not a road closure.

1lbswzo.q: The sign shown is found on main extra-urban roads
1lbswzo.why: The sign is placed where you leave a built-up area, on any road, not only on main extra-urban roads.

r4mmfs.q: The sign shown indicates the start of the built-up area
r4mmfs.why: The diagonal red bar marks the end of the built-up area, not the start.

1pv7xm9.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a pedestrian area
1pv7xm9.why: The sign reads area pedonale with the pedestrian symbol, so it marks the start of a pedestrian area. The panel below lists the exceptions.

xvhhwb.q: The sign shown indicates, in the supplementary panel, the vehicles that may enter
xvhhwb.why: The panel under the sign lists the categories of vehicles allowed to enter, with their times and conditions.

1k6nvmq.q: The sign shown allows vehicles to circulate for loading and unloading goods
1k6nvmq.why: The panel shows a goods-handling symbol: vehicles loading or unloading goods may enter during the times shown, 14.00-16.00 and 24.00-9.00.

7yw2lq.q: The sign shown allows vehicles to circulate for disabled persons
7yw2lq.why: The panel shows vehicles authorised to serve disabled people (wheelchair symbol), and these may enter the area.

xxcdgi.q: The sign shown indicates a police station
xxcdgi.why: The sign marks a pedestrian area (area pedonale). The police appear only among the emergency vehicles allowed in, not as a station.

16xflq7.q: The sign shown indicates an area reserved only for disabled persons
16xflq7.why: The area is a pedestrian area. Vehicles serving disabled people are just one of several categories allowed in.

h2gfvu.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of police on foot
h2gfvu.why: The sign marks a pedestrian area. Police are only listed among the emergency vehicles allowed in on urgent duty.

15qobrl.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of street vendors
15qobrl.why: The sign marks a pedestrian area (area pedonale), with listed exceptions. It says nothing about street vendors.

nym3sh.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a limited traffic zone
nym3sh.why: The words zona traffico limitato (ZTL) with the no-entry disc mark the start of a limited traffic zone.

nw1srn.q: The sign shown indicates the start of the area where traffic is allowed only for certain categories of vehicles
nw1srn.why: In a ZTL, unauthorised vehicles may not enter. Only the categories listed on the panel are allowed in.

cn50qb.q: The sign shown shows which vehicles may enter
cn50qb.why: The panel under the sign lists the vehicles allowed in, such as vehicles for disabled people, police, ambulances and goods vehicles at the times shown.

3c2g0q.q: The sign shown shows the categories of vehicles admitted to transit
3c2g0q.why: The panel lists the categories allowed through the zone, with any time limits. The ban applies to everyone else.

x8r5oz.q: The sign shown indicates a one-way street
x8r5oz.why: The sign marks a limited traffic zone (ZTL), not a one-way street. One-way streets use an arrow on a blue sign.

1f1aore.q: The sign shown prohibits the transit of all vehicles
1f1aore.why: The ban covers only unauthorised vehicles. The categories on the panel, such as emergency, disabled and goods vehicles at set times, may still enter.

1og4oxm.q: The sign shown indicates a military zone
1og4oxm.why: The sign marks an urban limited traffic zone (ZTL), not a military area.

16d6rym.q: The sign shown indicates that the road is closed because of heavy traffic
16d6rym.why: The sign marks a limited traffic zone (ZTL) with access for certain categories only. It does not mean closure due to heavy traffic.

17eftbj.q: The sign shown allows transit only for residents
17eftbj.why: The panel does not mention residents. It admits vehicles for disabled people, emergency vehicles and goods vehicles at set times.

1aqkme0.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a pedestrian area
1aqkme0.why: The sign reads zona traffico limitato (ZTL) with a red no-entry disc. A pedestrian area has a different sign, with a pedestrian symbol.

1eor3a8.q: The sign shown lets you know the passability conditions of the Stelvio pass
1eor3a8.why: The sign names STELVIO and tells you whether the pass is open or closed, and what winter equipment is needed to drive it.

1tor6uj.q: The sign shown indicates that you may travel only with chains or winter tyres
1tor6uj.why: The chain symbol means you may drive only with snow chains or winter tyres fitted.

8hjo2l.q: The sign shown indicates that the road is open, but only to vehicles equipped with chains or winter tyres
8hjo2l.why: The green panel says open (aperto), but the chain symbol makes snow chains or winter tyres compulsory.

ssw695.q: The sign shown is placed on mountain roads
ssw695.why: The sign gives pass conditions for the Stelvio and is placed on mountain roads approaching the pass.

1eu944w.q: The sign shown indicates that it is possible to reach the Stelvio pass
1eu944w.why: The green panel reads open (aperto), so the Stelvio pass can be reached, with chains or winter tyres.

1yr56wn.q: The sign shown indicates a road open only to vehicles with new tyres
1yr56wn.why: The sign says nothing about new tyres. It requires snow chains or winter tyres.

duc9vw.q: The sign shown recommends fitting chains
duc9vw.why: The chain symbol is not advice. It means chains or winter tyres are compulsory to drive the road.

miwtjt.q: The sign shown requires fitting chains on all four wheels
miwtjt.why: The sign requires chains or winter tyres. It does not require chains on all four wheels.

2h4iht.q: The sign shown requires removing chains so as not to damage the asphalt
2h4iht.why: The sign requires chains or winter tyres. It never orders you to remove them.

c6a6th.q: The sign shown indicates the opening of a ski facility
c6a6th.why: The sign reports road conditions on the Stelvio pass. It has nothing to do with ski facilities.

1lxpg80.q: The sign shown advises proceeding with particular care and attention
1lxpg80.why: The sign says the pass is closed and that chains or winter tyres are advised as far as Trafoi, so extra caution is needed.

ujsgy5.q: The sign shown indicates that the Stelvio pass cannot be reached
ujsgy5.why: The red panel reads closed (chiuso), so the Stelvio pass cannot be reached.

16eqvuq.q: The sign shown recommends the use of chains or winter tyres as far as Trafoi
16eqvuq.why: The panel shows winter tyres and chains with the words fino a Trafoi (as far as Trafoi), so they are recommended up to that point.

98ut4e.q: The sign shown indicates that it is possible to get as far as Trafoi
98ut4e.why: The words fino a Trafoi mean the road can be driven only as far as Trafoi, after which the pass is closed.

o44jl2.q: The sign shown indicates that service stations are closed
o44jl2.why: The sign is about whether the Stelvio pass is passable. It says nothing about service stations.

4meqcu.q: The sign shown indicates that fitting winter tyres is compulsory
4meqcu.why: With the pass closed, the sign only recommends chains or winter tyres as far as Trafoi. It does not make them compulsory.

1nokcmc.q: The sign shown prohibits transit for vehicles that do not have snow chains
1nokcmc.why: The sign informs and advises chains or winter tyres as far as Trafoi. It does not ban vehicles without them.

uk9elw.q: The sign shown means that vehicles must carry chains on board in order to pass
uk9elw.why: The sign recommends chains or winter tyres as far as Trafoi. It is not an obligation to carry chains in order to pass.

1w7rjd6.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a main extraurban road
1w7rjd6.why: The blue sign showing a road with separated carriageways marks the start of a main extraurban road (strada extraurbana principale).

19tn11k.q: The sign shown if crossed by a red stripe indicates the end of a main extraurban road
19tn11k.why: With a red diagonal bar the sign marks the end of the main extraurban road and of its rules.

1outqi.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of a main extraurban road
1outqi.why: The sign is placed at the start of a main extraurban road to show that its rules apply from that point.

1feq5fw.q: The sign shown indicates a road with separated carriageways
1feq5fw.why: The symbol shows two distinct carriageways with a central divider, typical of a main extraurban road.

1thhjnh.q: The sign shown indicates an overpass that allows U-turns
1thhjnh.why: The sign marks a main extraurban road. U-turns are not allowed on such a road.

1kof3ni.q: The sign shown warns of an uphill stretch of road
1kof3ni.why: An uphill gradient is shown by a triangular danger sign. This blue sign marks a main extraurban road.

1yonk4d.q: The sign shown indicates the proximity of an underpass for vehicles
1yonk4d.why: The blue sign marks a main extraurban road, not an underpass. The drawing shows two separated carriageways.

181cpot.q: The sign shown indicates that the road is interrupted
181cpot.why: The sign marks the start of a main extraurban road. A road interruption is shown by other signs.

jocamg.q: The sign shown requires driving in parallel lines
jocamg.why: It is an information sign and does not prescribe parallel-line driving. It marks a main extraurban road.

eop6xt.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of the start of a long straight stretch
eop6xt.why: The sign marks the start of a main extraurban road. It does not warn of a long straight stretch.

1sl2576.q: The sign shown is placed near the Italian border, visible to drivers coming from abroad
1sl2576.why: The sign marked ITALIA is placed near the border where drivers coming from abroad can see it, and shows the general speed limits.

w7438h.q: The sign shown indicates the general maximum speed limits that apply in Italy
w7438h.why: The sign shows the general maximum speed limits in Italy: 50, 90, 110 and 130 km/h depending on the type of road.

5tta7i.q: The sign shown indicates, in the first top box, the maximum speed limit in built-up areas
5tta7i.why: The top box, with 50 and a city skyline, shows the 50 km/h maximum in built-up areas (centri abitati).

1wkmn9.q: The sign shown indicates 90 km/h as the maximum speed limit on secondary extraurban roads
1wkmn9.why: The second box, with 90 and a crossed-out town, shows 90 km/h outside built-up areas on secondary extraurban roads.

xo0hen.q: The sign shown indicates 110 km/h as the maximum speed limit on main extraurban roads
xo0hen.why: The third box, with 110 and the blue main-road symbol, shows a 110 km/h limit on main extraurban roads.

19sjph2.q: The sign shown indicates 130 km/h as the maximum speed limit on motorways
19sjph2.why: The fourth box, with 130 and the green motorway symbol, shows a 130 km/h maximum on motorways (autostrade).

zidhcd.q: The sign shown indicates 90 km/h as the maximum speed limit in built-up areas
zidhcd.why: In built-up areas the general limit is 50 km/h, shown in the first box. 90 km/h applies on secondary extraurban roads.

1bpv2gh.q: The sign shown indicates the number of motorways in Italy that can be driven without paying a toll
1bpv2gh.why: The sign shows maximum speed limits. It says nothing about toll-free motorways.

rfwc3w.q: The sign shown indicates 130 km/h as the maximum speed limit on main extraurban roads
rfwc3w.why: On main extraurban roads the limit is 110 km/h. 130 km/h applies only on motorways.

1bxkeuo.q: The sign shown is found at the entrance of every city
1bxkeuo.why: The general speed-limit sign is placed near the border for drivers entering Italy, not at the entrance of every city.

vd6hma.q: The sign shown indicates the minimum speed limits that apply in Italy
vd6hma.why: The values shown are maximum speed limits, not minimums.

1k05kr4.q: The sign shown indicates the motorway number
1k05kr4.why: The green sign with A25 identifies the motorway by its letter and number.

1aszkb2.q: The sign shown may be found inside an advance warning sign for a motorway junction
1aszkb2.why: The motorway number can appear inside junction advance signs to show which motorway you are heading to.

1wxr5rd.q: The sign shown combined with an arrow indicates the direction to a motorway toll booth
1wxr5rd.why: Combined with an arrow, the motorway number sign shows the direction to the toll booth (casello) of that motorway.

7pe20l.q: The sign shown identifies motorway no. 25
7pe20l.why: The code A25 identifies motorway number 25.

1awr4ag.q: The sign shown is found at the border with Austria
1awr4ag.why: The sign gives a motorway number, not a border. Border signs show the general speed limits.

tpgko4.q: The sign shown indicates the number of the overpass
tpgko4.why: The green A25 sign identifies a motorway, not an overpass.

yeo59y.q: The sign shown indicates the safe distance to keep from the vehicle ahead
yeo59y.why: The sign gives a motorway number. Safety distance depends on speed and conditions and is not shown this way.

36l8av.q: The sign shown indicates a service centre 25 kilometres away
36l8av.why: The 25 is part of the A25 code identifying the motorway. It is not a distance in kilometres.

127xowy.q: The sign shown indicates that the next motorway junction is 25 kilometres away
127xowy.why: A25 identifies the motorway. It does not show the distance to the next junction.

1bezitm.q: The sign shown indicates the minimum speed limit that it is advised not to exceed
1bezitm.why: The sign has nothing to do with speed. It shows the code A25 of a motorway.

1m7uwl8.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a built-up area
1m7uwl8.why: The white sign with a place name marks the start of a built-up area (centro abitato).

13qynut.q: The sign shown identifies the locality reached
13qynut.why: The sign shows the name of the locality reached, here Taranto.

1qb404b.q: The sign shown is placed at the start of the built-up area, on all roads entering the indicated locality
1qb404b.why: The sign is placed at the start of the built-up area on every road entering the named locality.

mo0z1d.q: The sign shown if crossed by a red stripe indicates the end of the built-up area
mo0z1d.why: With a red diagonal stripe the sign marks the end of the built-up area.

1xoinug.q: The sign shown indicates a tourist locality
1xoinug.why: The white name sign marks the start of a built-up area. Tourist places are shown on brown signs.

9mbbwi.q: The sign shown is placed to indicate the end of a province
9mbbwi.why: The sign has nothing to do with provincial boundaries. It marks the start of the built-up area of Taranto.

mozgjl.q: The sign shown indicates the direction to follow to reach Taranto
mozgjl.why: The sign has no arrow. It marks the start of the built-up area of Taranto and gives no direction.

1qxfr1j.q: The sign shown identifies a viaduct
1qxfr1j.why: The white sign with a name marks the start of a built-up area, not a viaduct.

1u42j8l.q: The sign shown indicates the entrance to a medical first-aid station
1u42j8l.why: The red cross on white indicates a medical first-aid station (pronto soccorso), and the arrow shows where it is.

1k553dy.q: The sign shown indicates the direction to enter the first-aid station
1k553dy.why: The arrow under the red cross shows the direction to follow to reach the first-aid station.

1yp36sm.q: The sign shown is placed at a first-aid station
1yp36sm.why: The sign is placed at the first-aid station to show its position.

du7h8w.q: The sign shown indicates a border crossing with Switzerland
du7h8w.why: The red cross sign indicates first aid. Border crossings use different signs.

vq5g5w.q: The sign shown indicates a pharmacy
vq5g5w.why: The red cross indicates first aid. Pharmacies use a different symbol.

1rbkgnb.q: The sign shown indicates the road to follow to reach the cemetery
1rbkgnb.why: The sign with a red cross and arrow points to first aid, not to a cemetery.

hdhy5k.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a four-way junction
hdhy5k.why: The sign indicates first aid. Junctions are announced by triangular danger signs.

9gx4ca.q: The sign shown indicates a parking area reserved for doctors
9gx4ca.why: The red cross indicates first aid, not doctors' parking, which would show the P symbol.

gyvkyg.q: The sign shown is located near a bridge crossing the river Arno
gyvkyg.why: The brown sign with waves and the name fiume Arno is placed near a bridge crossing the Arno.

v6jnqo.q: The sign shown indicates the name of the river near the bridge that crosses it
v6jnqo.why: The panel under the water symbol shows the river name, here Arno, near the bridge that crosses it.

e11umm.q: The sign shown is one of the information signs
e11umm.why: It belongs to the information signs (segnali di indicazione), which give useful information and impose no rules.

nhgfgp.q: The sign shown is placed where the road may flood when it rains
nhgfgp.why: The sign gives the river name near the bridge. Flooding risk is shown by danger signs.

1x2nmg9.q: The sign shown indicates the danger of storm surges
1x2nmg9.why: This is a tourist territory sign naming a river (here the Arno): it shows a watercourse, not a hazard or an activity.

1tq7ngx.q: The sign shown indicates that water skiing is possible
1tq7ngx.why: This is a tourist territory sign naming a river (here the Arno): it shows a watercourse, not a hazard or an activity.

wl1f4f.q: The sign shown indicates a road with a series of bends
wl1f4f.why: This is a tourist territory sign naming a river (here the Arno): it shows a watercourse, not a hazard or an activity.

2mcis3.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a tourist and hotel information office
2mcis3.why: The brown sign with an "i" and a bed, with a 150 m panel, announces a tourist and hotel information office (ufficio informazioni) 150 metres ahead.

15pswmd.q: The sign shown indicates the possibility of getting information about hotels and motels
15pswmd.why: The brown sign with an "i" and a bed, with a 150 m panel, announces a tourist and hotel information office (ufficio informazioni) 150 metres ahead.

17v5x9x.q: The sign shown indicates a place where you can ask for information about hotels
17v5x9x.why: The brown sign with an "i" and a bed, with a 150 m panel, announces a tourist and hotel information office (ufficio informazioni) 150 metres ahead.

1gnr2md.q: The sign shown indicates the number of hotels in the vicinity
1gnr2md.why: The sign marks a tourist and hotel information point 150 m ahead, not how many hotels are nearby.

7w7d5v.q: The sign shown indicates the entrance to a hospital 150 metres ahead
7w7d5v.why: The "i" and bed symbols mean tourist and hotel information; a hospital has a different sign with a cross.

1ng2muk.q: The sign shown indicates the admissions office of the hospital
1ng2muk.why: The sign shows tourist and hotel information, not a hospital office: the bed stands for accommodation.

5vxkoo.q: The sign shown indicates that 150 metres ahead there is a hotel with interpreters for foreign guests
5vxkoo.why: The sign announces an information office for tourists and hotels (ufficio informazioni), not a hotel with interpreters.

neojor.q: The sign shown indicates an unsignalled (unregulated) pedestrian crossing
neojor.why: The square blue sign with a pedestrian on stripes marks a pedestrian crossing (attraversamento pedonale) not controlled by traffic lights or officers.

lqimy2.q: Outside built-up areas, the sign shown is placed after the ATTRAVERSAMENTO PEDONALE warning sign
lqimy2.why: Outside built-up areas the warning sign comes first; the blue information sign then appears at the crossing itself.

f1suap.q: The sign shown is placed directly at the stripes of the pedestrian crossing
f1suap.why: The blue sign is placed right at the zebra stripes (strisce pedonali), not before them.

12yqgv2.q: The sign shown obliges drivers to stop when pedestrians are using the pedestrian crossings
12yqgv2.why: Drivers must give way to pedestrians crossing on the stripes and stop if necessary.

nzlkce.q: The sign shown indicates an underpass
nzlkce.why: The sign shows a pedestrian crossing at road level with stripes, not an underpass.

1gvdsbp.q: The sign shown is placed 150 metres before a pedestrian crossing
1gvdsbp.why: The blue sign stands at the crossing itself; advance warning at a distance is the job of the triangular danger sign.

fo0onl.q: The sign shown, if green, is placed on a motorway
fo0onl.why: Pedestrians are not allowed on motorways, so there are no crossings there; this sign is blue, not green.

1r1jhro.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of an elementary school
1r1jhro.why: The sign marks a pedestrian crossing, not a school; schools have their own danger sign.

ari0yo.q: The sign shown allows overtaking a vehicle that has stopped to give way to pedestrians
ari0yo.why: Overtaking a vehicle stopped to let pedestrians cross is forbidden at pedestrian crossings.

1xrbxfq.q: The sign shown, if placed on the edge of the pavement, indicates a school bus stop
1xrbxfq.why: The orange sign with schoolchildren, placed at the kerb, marks a school bus stop (scuolabus).

1ny4jlf.q: The sign shown, if placed on the outside of a bus, indicates that it is carrying schoolchildren
1ny4jlf.why: Displayed on a bus, the sign shows that it is carrying schoolchildren.

vqsmnn.q: The sign shown can indicate the stop of a bus carrying schoolchildren
vqsmnn.why: The sign can mark the stop of a bus used for transporting schoolchildren.

1nwktom.q: The sign shown warns you to watch out for children who may suddenly cross the road
1nwktom.why: The sign calls for extra caution because children may suddenly run across the road.

prcw25.q: The sign shown warns you to be careful because children who have got off the school bus may suddenly cross the road
prcw25.why: Near a school bus stop, children who have just got off may suddenly cross: slow down and take care.

10slbq3.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of unaccompanied children
10slbq3.why: The sign is not a prohibition: it signals schoolchildren and only requires caution.

1r62cf2.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of public gardens
1r62cf2.why: The orange sign means schoolchildren or a school bus stop, not public gardens.

1a26lhn.q: The sign shown indicates that it is mandatory to give way to children crossing
1a26lhn.why: The sign calls for caution but does not by itself impose a mandatory right of way for children.

x0mwpr.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of a device to be used when roadside assistance is requested
x0mwpr.why: The SOS sign marks a device for requesting roadside assistance (soccorso stradale).

na8297.q: The sign shown is placed on a call device for roadside assistance
na8297.why: The SOS sign is displayed on call devices for roadside assistance.

124017s.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of a device for calling roadside rescue
124017s.why: The SOS sign marks equipment for calling roadside rescue.

1hutbwc.q: The sign shown indicates a hospital zone
1hutbwc.why: The SOS sign means roadside assistance; a hospital zone has a different sign with an H.

1medr4a.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of a public telephone
1medr4a.why: The SOS sign marks a roadside rescue call device, not a public telephone.

qgs4mx.q: The sign shown indicates a parking area for ambulances
qgs4mx.why: The SOS sign does not mark ambulance parking; it marks a rescue call device.

1rbagpg.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a state secondary school
1rbagpg.why: The SOS sign relates to roadside rescue; it does not announce schools.

1ufmhh7.q: The sign shown is placed at the beginning of a road that is a dead end for vehicles
1ufmhh7.why: The sign is placed at the start of a no-through road (strada senza uscita) for vehicles.

mla95v.q: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles
mla95v.why: The sign applies to all vehicles, motorcycles included.

1yf6ear.q: The sign shown indicates a road with no way out for vehicles
1yf6ear.why: The sign shows a road with no through exit (strada senza sbocco) for vehicles.

1p3dt9h.why: The sign is informational only: it marks a dead-end road and does not ban parking.

1pdxu1s.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a "T" junction
1pdxu1s.why: The sign shows a dead-end road, not a T junction; the red bar represents the closed end.

1ce59fi.q: The sign shown is placed near a tobacconist's
1ce59fi.why: The sign indicates a no-through road and has nothing to do with tobacconists.

38t089.why: The sign shows a dead-end road; roadworks use a triangular danger sign.

wc2ue1.why: The sign informs that the road is a dead end; it does not prohibit U-turns.

1hqcw6i.q: The sign shown prohibits entry also for pedestrians
1hqcw6i.why: The sign is informational and bars no one from entering, pedestrians included.

1k8crn4.q: The sign shown warns that the road on the right is a dead end for vehicles
1k8crn4.why: The sign warns that the side road on the right is a dead end for vehicles.

kwnmdj.q: The sign shown allows turning right
kwnmdj.why: Only the side road is a dead end, so turning right is allowed (the main road continues).

l7wnzs.q: The sign shown allows continuing straight ahead
l7wnzs.why: The sign shows the main road continues, so you may go straight on.

8zj890.q: The sign shown also applies to motorcycles
8zj890.why: The sign applies to all vehicles, motorcycles included.

ppnyxg.q: The sign shown is one of the information signs (segnali di indicazione)
ppnyxg.why: The dead-end sign belongs to the information signs (segnali di indicazione).

156xl1l.q: The sign shown prohibits the U-turn manoeuvre
156xl1l.why: The sign informs about a dead end on the right and does not prohibit U-turns.

tmk03h.q: The sign shown prohibits turning right
tmk03h.why: Turning right is not prohibited: the sign only warns that that road is a dead end.

cka6hb.q: The sign shown indicates a lay-by on the right
cka6hb.why: The sign shows a dead-end road on the right, not a lay-by (piazzola di sosta).

1esajiu.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a parking area on the right
1esajiu.why: The sign announces a dead-end road, not a parking area.

wljo.q: The sign shown also applies to pedestrians
wljo.why: The sign concerns vehicles; pedestrians may still have a way through.

1r3r79z.q: The sign shown indicates the speed that it is recommended not to exceed in optimal traffic conditions
1r3r79z.why: The blue sign with a number gives the recommended speed (velocità consigliata), to be not exceeded in ideal conditions; it is not a limit.

ljvewh.q: The sign shown allows travelling at 50 km/h
ljvewh.why: The recommended speed is 60 km/h, so driving slower, at 50 km/h, is allowed.

14civi9.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel indicating the length of the road section where it is recommended not to exceed the indicated speed
14civi9.why: A supplementary panel can show the length of the stretch where the recommended speed applies.

1aosr5k.q: The sign shown, if crossed by a red stripe, indicates the end of its validity
1aosr5k.why: A red diagonal bar across the sign marks the end of its validity.

16tv4qu.q: The sign shown allows travelling at 70 km/h on extra-urban roads
16tv4qu.why: The general limit of the road still applies; 70 km/h is below it and allowed, since 60 is only a recommendation.

ronlek.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles exceeding 60 tonnes fully loaded
ronlek.why: The blue sign bans nothing: it shows a recommended speed. Weight limits use red circular signs.

1w22yqg.q: The sign shown indicates a minimum speed limit
1w22yqg.why: The sign shows a recommended speed, not a minimum limit (which uses a different, mandatory sign).

1r3i3lu.q: The sign shown prohibits exceeding the indicated speed
1r3i3lu.why: It is only a recommendation, not a ban: limits are shown on circular signs with a red border.

9f4tce.q: The sign shown indicates the safety distance to keep from the vehicle in front
9f4tce.why: The number is a recommended speed in km/h, not a distance.

14dmp24.q: The sign shown indicates that it is not possible to travel at a lower speed than the one shown
14dmp24.why: The sign is only a recommended maximum, so travelling slower is allowed.

11nf1aa.q: The sign shown indicates the kilometres already travelled from the origin of the road
11nf1aa.why: Distance travelled is shown on other panels; this one gives the recommended speed.

316wpe.q: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for the circulation of motor vehicles only
316wpe.why: The blue sign with a car marks a road reserved for motor vehicles only (strada riservata ai veicoli a motore); bicycles and non-motorised vehicles are excluded.

1dvy6t3.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of bicycles
1dvy6t3.why: The blue sign with a car marks a road reserved for motor vehicles only (strada riservata ai veicoli a motore); bicycles and non-motorised vehicles are excluded.

15vcf1w.q: The sign shown is placed at the beginning of a road reserved for the circulation of motor vehicles
15vcf1w.why: The blue sign with a car marks a road reserved for motor vehicles only (strada riservata ai veicoli a motore); bicycles and non-motorised vehicles are excluded.

8wnpgh.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles without a motor
8wnpgh.why: The blue sign with a car marks a road reserved for motor vehicles only (strada riservata ai veicoli a motore); bicycles and non-motorised vehicles are excluded.

3oofhb.q: The sign shown allows the passage of buses
3oofhb.why: Buses are motor vehicles, so they may use a road with this sign.

1xk0bce.q: The sign shown, if crossed by a red stripe, indicates the end of its validity
1xk0bce.why: A red diagonal bar across the sign marks the end of its validity.

fhgdqi.q: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for taxis only
fhgdqi.why: The sign reserves the road for motor vehicles in general, not just taxis.

hilsnk.q: The sign shown indicates a car park for cars only
hilsnk.why: The sign marks a motor-vehicle road, not a car park, which uses a P sign.

oe1c8q.q: The sign shown allows a bicycle to travel along that road
oe1c8q.why: Bicycles are not motor vehicles and may not use a road with this sign.

14rd4o1.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of a lorry
14rd4o1.why: Lorries (autocarri) are motor vehicles and may use the road.

1hlo44x.q: The sign shown is placed at the beginning of a tunnel
1hlo44x.why: The green sign with a tunnel shape marks the start of a tunnel (galleria).

bo9unt.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a motorway tunnel
bo9unt.why: Green is the colour of motorway signs, so this announces a motorway tunnel.

y5y9fo.q: The sign shown reminds you to switch off the engine in case of a prolonged stop in a tunnel
y5y9fo.why: In a tunnel, if stopped for a long time, you must switch off the engine.

atydk.q: The sign shown reminds you not to park or stop in a tunnel, unless otherwise indicated
atydk.why: Stopping and parking in a tunnel are forbidden unless signs say otherwise.

1aamvs4.q: The sign shown invites you to hold the steering wheel firmly to cope with possible gusts of wind at the tunnel exit
1aamvs4.why: Gusts of crosswind can occur at the tunnel exit, so hold the steering wheel firmly.

i1j1ua.q: The sign shown indicates a closed road
i1j1ua.why: The sign marks a tunnel, not a closed road.

866qog.why: The sign marks a tunnel; roadworks use a triangular danger sign.

ez1020.q: The sign shown indicates an unlit tunnel
ez1020.why: The sign marks the start of a tunnel and says nothing about lighting.

lh02op.q: The sign shown prohibits the passage of vehicles exceeding 3.5 metres in height
lh02op.why: This is not a height ban, which would be a red circular sign. It marks a tunnel.

2ztxqj.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a bridge
2ztxqj.why: This tunnel-shaped sign marks a tunnel; a bridge has a different symbol.

1sdh4ig.why: The sign is informational and marks a tunnel; an overtaking ban is a red circular sign.

28zwh5.q: The sign shown can be found at the beginning of a bridge, a viaduct or an overpass
28zwh5.why: The green sign with a bridge shape marks the start of a bridge, viaduct (viadotto) or overpass.

18wtmcb.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel indicating the length of the overpass
18wtmcb.why: A supplementary panel can show the length of the overpass.

1zu16i.q: The sign shown warns you to take special care in strong wind
1zu16i.why: This is the bridge or viaduct (viadotto) sign: these raised, exposed structures often get strong gusts, so take extra care in high wind.

7fndzb.q: The sign shown tells you to keep a firm hold of the steering wheel to cope with sudden side gusts of wind
7fndzb.why: On a bridge or viaduct (viadotto), which is exposed to the wind, sudden side gusts can hit the car, so grip the steering wheel firmly.

1sh3c0f.q: The sign shown prohibits overtaking between motor vehicles
1sh3c0f.why: A no-overtaking order is shown by a round sign with a red border (divieto di sorpasso); this sign does not prohibit overtaking.

zgv1nk.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a tunnel
zgv1nk.why: The start of a tunnel (galleria) is shown by its own information sign with a tunnel mouth, not by this sign.

yy93ep.q: The sign shown indicates that you are about to pass under a bridge
yy93ep.why: The sign shows a bridge or viaduct you are about to drive over, not a bridge you will pass under.

1wm1car.q: The sign shown indicates a cycle crossing
1wm1car.why: The blue square sign with a cyclist marks a cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile).

1pf8fxk.q: The sign shown is placed at the stripes of the cycle crossing
1pf8fxk.why: The sign is placed right at the stripes of the cycle crossing, not in advance.

1bkkb75.q: The sign shown indicates that you must give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes
1bkkb75.why: You must give way to cyclists crossing on the stripes of a cycle crossing (attraversamento ciclabile).

1ct624q.q: The sign shown is paired with the stripes of a cycle crossing
1ct624q.why: The sign goes together with the markings of the cycle crossing and signals its presence.

79m207.q: The sign shown tells you to be careful because cyclists may be crossing the carriageway
79m207.why: The sign warns that cyclists cross the carriageway, so you must be careful and give them way.

15cakyw.q: The sign shown prohibits transit for vehicles without an engine
15cakyw.why: A ban on non-motorised vehicles is a round sign with a red border; this blue square sign prohibits nothing.

ibf62m.q: The sign shown prohibits transit for cyclists
ibf62m.why: A ban on bicycles (velocipedi) is a round red-bordered sign; this sign only marks a cycle crossing.

3ilfs5.q: The sign shown indicates a cycle path
3ilfs5.why: A cycle path (pista ciclabile) is shown by a round blue sign; this square sign shows a cycle crossing.

1utlzfb.q: The sign shown tells cyclists to turn left
1utlzfb.why: The sign gives no turning instruction; it only marks a cycle crossing.

10fm0jt.q: The sign shown obliges cyclists to give way to vehicles
10fm0jt.why: The sign protects crossing cyclists: it is vehicles that must give way to cyclists, not the reverse.

1d33xrx.q: The sign shown shows the route to follow to take the road on the left
1d33xrx.why: The diagram shows the indirect route to reach the road on the left: continue, turn right, then loop back across.

4hmppm.q: The sign shown indicates that it is not possible to turn left directly
4hmppm.why: The diagram shows that a direct left turn is not allowed; you must follow the indicated route instead.

1om9p56.q: The sign shown allows you to go straight on
1om9p56.why: The indicated route starts by going straight on, so continuing straight is allowed.

paxih1.q: The sign shown allows turning right
paxih1.why: The indicated route includes a right turn, so turning right is allowed.

10b47yk.q: The sign shown concerns drivers who intend to take the road on the left
10b47yk.why: The diagram is for drivers who want to take the left-hand road and shows how to do it.

13v3cuq.q: The sign shown obliges you to turn left at the next intersection
13v3cuq.why: The sign imposes no obligation; it is an information sign showing how to reach the left-hand road.

qa5hy8.q: The sign shown indicates a car park on the left
qa5hy8.why: The sign does not show parking; the shape is just the looping route for an indirect left turn.

1px5qj.q: The sign shown does not apply to bicycles and mopeds
1px5qj.why: The sign applies to all vehicles wanting to turn left, including bicycles and mopeds.

mm4hif.q: The sign shown prohibits turning right
mm4hif.why: Turning right is not prohibited; it is actually part of the route shown.

febw1j.q: The sign shown indicates the route of buses that have stops nearby
febw1j.why: The sign shows the left-turn route for all vehicles, not a bus route.

ndrlah.q: The sign shown indicates, on roads with separate carriageways, an overpass for making a U-turn
ndrlah.why: On roads with separate carriageways, the sign shows a structure (overpass) allowing a U-turn.

1dqs7k0.q: The sign shown indicates, on roads with separate carriageways, an underpass for reversing direction
1dqs7k0.why: The structure can also be an underpass; the sign shows that you can reverse direction.

1vbsal1.q: The sign shown is placed on a road with separate carriageways
1vbsal1.why: It is placed on roads with separate carriageways, where U-turns are made via an overpass or underpass.

13ys0qe.q: The sign shown indicates a structure (overpass or underpass) that allows you to turn back
13ys0qe.why: The sign shows an overpass or underpass that lets you go back the other way.

mh7yks.q: The sign shown , on a green background, indicates on a motorway an overpass for making a U-turn
mh7yks.why: On a green background (motorway colour), the sign shows an overpass for a U-turn.

1et7jqq.q: The sign shown indicates that the road is closed because of roadworks
1et7jqq.why: The sign has nothing to do with roadworks; works are shown by the roadworks warning sign.

1i5d4m0.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a long straight stretch
1i5d4m0.why: There is no sign for a long straight; this one shows a structure for reversing direction.

1c01g3y.q: The sign shown indicates the start of a main extraurban road
1c01g3y.why: The start of a main extra-urban road has its own sign; this one shows a U-turn facility.

1k5loaq.q: The sign shown indicates a nearby at-grade intersection (at the same level as the road)
1k5loaq.why: The sign shows an overpass or underpass, a structure at a different level, not an at-grade junction.

1a7e39z.q: The sign shown obliges you to reverse direction
1a7e39z.why: This is an information sign: it shows that you can reverse direction, not that you must.

1bfkkfd.q: The sign shown indicates a lay-by beside the carriageway for stopping
1bfkkfd.why: The sign shows a lay-by (piazzola) beside the carriageway where you can stop.

1l9u2ez.q: The sign shown is placed near a lay-by for stopping
1l9u2ez.why: The sign is placed close to the lay-by it indicates.

1cv5kyf.q: The sign shown is found on extraurban roads
1cv5kyf.why: The blue background indicates an extra-urban road, where lay-bys are found.

cdesm0.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel indicating the distance between the sign and the lay-by
cdesm0.why: It can be combined with a supplementary panel giving the distance to the lay-by.

15ex6b6.q: The sign shown warns of a widening of the carriageway
15ex6b6.why: A widening of the carriageway has its own sign; this one shows a lay-by.

sx7olh.q: The sign shown indicates that parking is allowed for only 3 hours
sx7olh.why: The sign gives no time limit; it only shows a lay-by for stopping.

18hl7g1.q: The sign shown indicates a camping area
18hl7g1.why: A camping area has a tent symbol; this sign shows a lay-by.

1hgna89.q: The sign shown indicates a bus stop
1hgna89.why: A bus stop has a sign with a bus symbol; this one shows a lay-by.

xhba8d.q: The sign shown indicates a parking area for caravans
xhba8d.why: Caravan areas have their own sign; this one shows a plain lay-by.

1ksm9y.q: The sign shown is placed only on motorways
1ksm9y.why: Blue signs are for extra-urban roads; motorway signs have a green background.

19z3i4j.q: The sign shown indicates how to use the lanes of a carriageway
19z3i4j.why: The sign shows how to use the lanes of a carriageway, with a truck ban on the left lane.

3fpwmb.q: The sign shown allows motorcycles to travel in both lanes
3fpwmb.why: Only heavy trucks are restricted; motorcycles may use both lanes.

9i9397.q: The sign shown indicates that the left lane is closed to trucks exceeding a maximum laden mass of 3.5 tonnes
9i9397.why: The truck ban symbol closes the left lane to vehicles over 3.5 tonnes laden mass.

kbsbgx.q: The sign shown is installed on extraurban roads
kbsbgx.why: The blue background shows the sign is used on extra-urban roads.

o0lg50.q: The sign shown allows cars to use both lanes
o0lg50.why: The ban applies only to trucks; cars may use both lanes.

j1lpwd.q: The sign shown allows all trucks to overtake on the right
j1lpwd.why: The sign does not permit overtaking on the right; overtaking is done on the left.

1ljsw7y.q: The sign shown indicates that trucks over 3.5 tonnes may only travel in the left lane
1ljsw7y.why: Trucks over 3.5 tonnes are banned from the left lane, not restricted to it.

2h8jps.q: The sign shown prohibits all trucks from using the left lane
2h8jps.why: The ban covers only trucks with laden mass over 3.5 tonnes, not all trucks.

8za1oa.q: The sign shown also prohibits transit for buses
8za1oa.why: The symbol concerns trucks only; buses are not affected.

171f1i8.q: The sign shown is found only on two-way roads
171f1i8.why: The sign shows lanes in the same direction, so it can also appear on one-way carriageways.

1vurr20.q: The sign shown indicates the mandatory minimum speeds to maintain on the indicated lanes
1vurr20.why: The blue circles show mandatory minimum speeds per lane: 90 km/h on the left, 60 km/h in the middle.

16eciy6.q: The sign shown is placed on motorways
16eciy6.why: The green background shows the sign is used on motorways (autostrade).

1n1dr2v.q: The sign shown allows a vehicle travelling at 100 km/h to use the middle lane
1n1dr2v.why: The middle lane has a 60 km/h minimum, so a vehicle at 100 km/h may use it.

1ay23yh.q: The sign shown requires vehicles travelling at 50 km/h to stay in the first lane on the right
1ay23yh.why: Below 60 km/h you must use the right lane, which has no minimum speed.

5l6z1g.q: The sign shown allows driving at 160 km/h in all three lanes
5l6z1g.why: The numbers are minimum speeds and the motorway maximum is 130 km/h.

1k0wqk.q: The sign shown shows speeds that it is advised not to exceed
1k0wqk.why: The blue circles show mandatory minimum speeds, not recommended maximums.

7avko2.q: The sign shown allows a vehicle travelling at 80 km/h to stay in the left lane
7avko2.why: The left lane has a 90 km/h minimum, so 80 km/h is not allowed there.

ni4qea.q: The sign shown indicates a two-way road
ni4qea.why: All arrows point the same way, so this is one carriageway in a single direction.

hpm60z.q: The sign shown indicates recommended speeds
hpm60z.why: The speeds shown are mandatory minimums, not recommended speeds.

wnwogx.q: The sign shown indicates how the lanes must be used
wnwogx.why: The sign shows how the lanes are to be used: the right lane is reserved for buses.

1elfut4.q: The sign shown indicates that the right lane is reserved for public urban buses
1elfut4.why: The bus symbol on the right lane reserves it for public urban buses.

mi8rjw.q: The sign shown indicates that the left lanes are for normal traffic of all vehicles
mi8rjw.why: The two left lanes, with no symbols, are open to all vehicles.

468fnb.q: The sign shown is placed on urban roads
468fnb.why: The white background indicates a sign for urban roads.

1qibk33.q: The sign shown allows taxis to use the right lane
1qibk33.why: The lane is reserved for buses; taxis may use it only if a sign allows.

e9esgl.q: The sign shown indicates a cycle path on the right
e9esgl.why: The right lane is reserved for buses, not for cyclists.

11w9zrl.q: The sign shown can be found on motorways
11w9zrl.why: White is for urban roads; motorways have no urban bus lanes.

qmuv1d.q: The sign shown indicates that buses may overtake on the right
qmuv1d.why: The sign does not authorise overtaking on the right; overtaking is on the left.

11jfhi8.q: The sign shown indicates a change in the number of available lanes
11jfhi8.why: The sign shows a change in the number of lanes, here an increase.

vawiy3.q: The sign shown indicates an increase from one to two lanes
vawiy3.why: The splitting arrow shows that one lane becomes two.

wjek3u.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the distance to the point where the lane increase begins
wjek3u.why: A supplementary panel can show the distance to where the extra lane begins.

1yhz8uc.q: The sign shown is placed on extraurban roads
1yhz8uc.why: The blue background shows it is used on extra-urban roads.

1hfs19y.q: The sign shown indicates that you are near an overpass that allows reversing direction
1hfs19y.why: The sign shows a lane increase, not a U-turn overpass.

1hfdw20.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a mandatory right turn
1hfdw20.why: The sign does not require any turn; it only shows an additional lane.

1sjg06i.q: The sign shown indicates the possibility of passing to the right or left of an obstacle
1sjg06i.why: Passing an obstacle on either side has a different sign.

ams649.q: The sign shown indicates that overtaking on the right is possible
ams649.why: The sign does not allow overtaking on the right; it only shows more lanes.

ida6f2.q: The sign shown announces a pre-selection zone
ida6f2.why: The sign has nothing to do with pre-selection; it shows an increase in lanes.

1vn7t3y.q: The sign shown announces a deceleration lane
1vn7t3y.why: The sign shows an added lane, not a deceleration lane.

rx1pxz.q: The sign shown indicates a decrease in the number of available lanes
rx1pxz.why: The sign shows fewer lanes ahead: the right lane ends.

ayqom4.q: The sign shown indicates a reduction from three to two lanes
ayqom4.why: The three arrows show that three lanes become two.

6gfghy.q: The sign shown advises slowing down because of a narrowing of the carriageway
6gfghy.why: Fewer lanes means a narrowing, so slowing down is advisable.

jn0tvm.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing the distance from the lane narrowing
jn0tvm.why: A supplementary panel can show the distance to the lane narrowing.

1ml2af1.q: The sign shown is installed on motorways
1ml2af1.why: The green background shows it is installed on motorways (autostrade).

75bku7.q: The sign shown indicates roadworks in progress
75bku7.why: The green motorway panel shows the lane layout: two lanes continue straight and the right-hand lane shifts to the left. It does not signal roadworks, which use yellow signs.

slr1f0.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of an obligation to turn left
slr1f0.why: The green motorway panel shows the lane layout: two lanes continue straight and the right-hand lane shifts to the left. It is not a turn obligation.

c4akuq.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of an overpass that allows U-turns
c4akuq.why: The green motorway panel shows the lane layout: two lanes continue straight and the right-hand lane shifts to the left. It has nothing to do with overpasses or U-turns.

p8cc49.q: The sign shown indicates that you must give way to vehicles entering the motorway
p8cc49.why: The green motorway panel shows the lane layout: two lanes continue straight and the right-hand lane shifts to the left. It does not impose any duty to give way.

1t7png4.q: The sign shown advises the vehicles represented on the panel to follow the direction indicated
1t7png4.why: The white panel with a right arrow and silhouettes of a road train (autotreno) and an articulated lorry (autoarticolato) advises those vehicle types to follow the arrow.

10do5vq.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a recommended diversion for road trains and articulated lorries in transit
10do5vq.why: The panel shows a recommended route, a diversion, for heavy vehicles such as road trains and articulated lorries passing through.

1ahbf8w.q: The sign shown advises turning right for the vehicle categories represented
1ahbf8w.why: The panel recommends turning right for the vehicle categories shown on it.

11rlp1s.q: The sign shown is not a mandatory sign
11rlp1s.why: The sign is an information sign recommending a direction. Mandatory signs are round and blue, so this is not one.

mzysi4.q: The sign shown advises road trains and articulated lorries which direction to take to avoid going through the built-up area
mzysi4.why: The panel suggests a route that lets heavy vehicles avoid driving through the built-up area (centro abitato).

1daifv7.q: The sign shown prohibits road trains and articulated lorries from turning right
1daifv7.why: The sign recommends turning right for these vehicles. It does not prohibit it.

z6sxo7.q: The sign shown tells lorries to overtake on the right
z6sxo7.why: The sign gives a recommended direction. It has no connection with overtaking rules.

uneb7r.q: The sign shown indicates to lorries the direction to the city centre
uneb7r.why: Such a sign is generally meant to help heavy vehicles bypass the city centre, not to reach it.

1li8cb7.q: The sign shown announces the obligation to turn right immediately for the vehicles represented
1li8cb7.why: The sign only recommends a route. It creates no obligation, and certainly not to turn right immediately.

h0zuq1.q: The sign shown indicates that the vehicles represented on the panel must turn right immediately
h0zuq1.why: This is an information sign that recommends a route. It does not force the vehicles to turn right immediately.

1qm8y40.q: The sign shown warns lorries to move into the right-hand lane to get past an obstacle
1qm8y40.why: The sign shows a recommended route for heavy vehicles. It has nothing to do with changing lane to pass an obstacle.

wihkta.q: The sign shown indicates a stop for extra-urban public transport buses
wihkta.why: The blue sign with a coach-type bus marks a stop for extra-urban (extraurbano) public transport buses.

f41viw.q: The sign shown can be combined with a panel showing departure times of extra-urban buses
f41viw.why: The sign can have a panel below it with departure times for the extra-urban buses.

1wai4lu.q: The sign shown indicates the place to wait for an extra-urban public transport bus
1wai4lu.why: The sign marks the place where passengers wait for the extra-urban bus.

j00xh8.q: The sign shown indicates a ban on buses
j00xh8.why: This is a blue information sign. A ban on buses would be a round sign with a red border.

12tya9c.q: The sign shown indicates a lane reserved for buses
12tya9c.why: The sign marks a bus stop. A reserved lane (corsia riservata) uses a different sign and markings.

1678ii7.q: The sign shown indicates a parking area for buses and trolleybuses
1678ii7.why: The sign marks a stop of the extra-urban service, not a parking area for buses and trolleybuses.

1gofhe2.q: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for buses
1gofhe2.why: The sign marks a bus stop, not a road reserved for buses.

1p7uxpk.q: The sign shown indicates a car park and a bus stop nearby
1p7uxpk.why: The sign combines a car park (P) with a bus stop symbol and the bus numbers 8 and 45: parking with a bus stop nearby.

iq9k3i.q: The sign shown is placed near a bus stop
iq9k3i.why: The sign shows parking plus bus lines 8 and 45, so it is placed near a bus stop.

lmogtc.q: The sign shown indicates that after parking the car you can take bus no. 8 or 45
lmogtc.why: The sign shows an interchange car park: after leaving the car you can take buses 8 and 45.

1fmmdbt.q: The sign shown indicates the numbers (8 and 45) of the public buses that have stops nearby
1fmmdbt.why: The numbers 8 and 45 are the public bus lines that have stops near the car park.

aiwx76.q: The sign shown indicates the possibility of parking the car and taking the bus
aiwx76.why: The sign shows you can park the car and continue your journey by bus.

12frc5l.q: The sign shown indicates a lay-by for buses
12frc5l.why: The sign shows a car park for drivers with a bus stop nearby, not a lay-by (piazzola) for buses.

gf7i5z.q: The sign shown is placed near a first aid station
gf7i5z.why: The sign is about parking and buses. It does not indicate a first aid station (pronto soccorso).

1edacip.q: The sign shown indicates the maximum number of buses that can park
1edacip.why: The numbers 8 and 45 are bus line numbers, not a limit on how many buses can park.

17kvczv.q: The sign shown indicates how many minutes a bus stays stopped
17kvczv.why: The numbers 8 and 45 identify bus lines, not stopping times in minutes.

4j96ym.q: The sign shown indicates that parking is allowed from 8.45 onwards
4j96ym.why: 8 and 45 are bus line numbers, not a parking time.

1bunz8z.q: The sign shown is located near a railway station
1bunz8z.why: The sign with a car and a bed on a railway wagon indicates a nearby station offering car-carrying trains (auto al seguito).

10tv9rv.q: The sign shown indicates the proximity of a large railway station where cars can be transported with the traveller
10tv9rv.why: The sign indicates a station with a service carrying the traveller's car on the train.

1692bu0.q: The sign shown is located near the access where cars are loaded onto the train
1692bu0.why: The sign is placed near the access point where cars are loaded onto the train.

1g3usav.q: The sign shown indicates, on extra-urban roads, a hotel with guarded parking
1g3usav.why: The sign is about car transport by train, not a hotel with guarded parking.

13sljay.q: The sign shown indicates the possibility of staying in the car while it is carried by train
13sljay.why: The sign shows the car carried by train while the traveller uses a sleeping car. You do not stay inside the car.

11f3b2y.q: The sign shown indicates that the area is covered by the satellite anti-theft signal
11f3b2y.why: The sign refers to the car-on-train service, not satellite anti-theft coverage.

1h5nn8n.q: The sign shown indicates an area reserved for motorhome parking
1h5nn8n.why: The sign shows the car-carrying train service. Motorhome (autocaravan) areas have a different sign.

qf0iob.q: The sign shown indicates an area equipped with discharge facilities for vehicles that have sanitary facilities
qf0iob.why: The sign with a motorhome and an arrow pointing to a drain marks an area with waste-disposal facilities for vehicles with on-board toilets.

g1n906.q: The sign shown indicates an area with sanitary facilities for collecting wastewater from motorhomes
g1n906.why: The sign marks facilities for collecting wastewater from motorhomes (autocaravan).

prahqw.q: The sign shown concerns all vehicles that have sanitary facilities
prahqw.why: The sign is relevant to every vehicle that has on-board sanitary facilities.

1by15jo.q: The sign shown indicates facilities that allow vehicles with sanitary facilities to discharge organic waste and grey and black water
1by15jo.why: The sign marks facilities where vehicles with on-board toilets can empty organic waste and grey and black water.

1icwkpq.q: The sign shown indicates the presence of toilets for travellers
1icwkpq.why: The sign is about waste discharge for vehicles, not public toilets for travellers.

zmpz4u.q: The sign shown indicates a road reserved for motorhomes
zmpz4u.why: The sign marks a discharge area, not a road reserved for motorhomes.

1n7s5nz.q: The sign shown indicates a facility for weighing motorhomes
1n7s5nz.why: The sign has nothing to do with weighing vehicles. It marks a waste-discharge facility.

121wjou.q: The sign shown warns of potholes in the carriageway
121wjou.why: This is a blue information sign. Danger signs are triangular with a red border.

1jkgsd.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a dangerous dip
1jkgsd.why: This is an information sign, not a hazard warning. Hazards such as a dip use triangular signs.

8n8j0f.q: The sign shown indicates a vehicle repair workshop
8n8j0f.why: The blue sign with a spanner marks a vehicle repair workshop (officina meccanica).

fp79xc.q: The sign shown indicates that there is a vehicle repair workshop nearby
fp79xc.why: The sign tells you a vehicle repair workshop is nearby.

x3240e.q: The sign shown indicates a vehicle repair workshop nearby
x3240e.why: The sign shows that a vehicle repair workshop is close by.

1hsen23.q: The sign shown indicates that a vehicle repair workshop can be found a short distance away
1hsen23.why: The sign shows a vehicle repair workshop within a short distance.

1y4sphz.q: The sign shown warns to watch out for workers leaving a factory
1y4sphz.why: This is a blue service information sign, not a danger warning about workers.

1qwttfp.q: The sign shown indicates a fuel station
1qwttfp.why: The sign marks a repair workshop. A fuel station uses a pump symbol.

1y43nbx.q: The sign shown indicates a rest area nearby
1y43nbx.why: The sign marks a repair workshop, not a rest area.

70q7fe.q: The sign shown indicates road workers at work on the road
70q7fe.why: The sign marks a repair workshop. Roadworks use a triangular danger sign.

1odot4z.q: The sign shown indicates the state border with a country that is part of the European Union
1odot4z.why: The blue sign with the stars and ITALIA marks the state border (confine di Stato) with a European Union country.

52dvfo.q: The sign shown is located at the state border with a European Union country
52dvfo.why: The sign stands at the state border with an EU country.

kl6k7n.q: The sign shown indicates the border between Italy and a European Union member state
kl6k7n.why: The sign marks the border between Italy and an EU member state.

1z0ocvm.q: The sign shown does not require stopping at the state border
1z0ocvm.why: The sign is only informative. There is no obligation to stop at borders between EU countries.

16n0mos.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of a police checkpoint near the state border
16n0mos.why: The sign marks the border. It does not announce a police checkpoint.

ogcscu.q: The sign shown is placed on the back of the vehicle to indicate the country where it is registered
ogcscu.why: This is a roadside border sign, not a vehicle nationality marking (such as a registration sticker).

1fk813p.q: The sign shown is placed on the back of the vehicle to indicate that it can only circulate in one European state
1fk813p.why: This is a roadside border sign. It is never fixed to vehicles, and no vehicle is limited to one state by it.

5wsm3o.q: The sign shown requires stopping at the border with a European Union state
5wsm3o.why: The sign does not require a stop at a border with an EU state.

tnmftf.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of the obligation to stop for a customs check when entering Italy
tnmftf.why: The sign is informative only and does not announce a compulsory customs stop.

5aqxk4.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a state border with a country that is part of the European Union
5aqxk4.why: The sign with FRANCE and the 1 km panel warns that an EU border is coming up.

hw85db.q: The sign shown is placed on roads leading to the state border with a European Union country
hw85db.why: The sign is placed on roads leading to the border with an EU country.

1pgdzqs.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the distance to the border with a state that is part of the European Union
1pgdzqs.why: The sign gives the distance to the border, here 1 km.

1qzjcvq.q: The sign shown does not require stopping for a customs check at the state border
1qzjcvq.why: The sign is informative. Between EU countries there is no obligation to stop for customs.

1engihm.q: The sign shown is located near a checkpoint
1engihm.why: The sign warns of the border, not a checkpoint.

h7oyx1.q: The sign shown is placed on the back of vehicles to indicate their nationality
h7oyx1.why: This is a roadside advance border sign. It is not displayed on vehicles.

b4t5ab.q: The sign shown is placed on the back of the vehicle to indicate that it belongs to a European Union citizen
b4t5ab.why: It is a roadside sign. It says nothing about the vehicle owner's citizenship.

4biqfj.q: The sign shown gives advance warning of the obligation to stop at the border with a European Union state
4biqfj.why: The sign announces no obligation to stop at all.

76u06j.q: The sign shown requires stopping for a customs check when entering the territory of a European country
76u06j.why: The sign does not require stopping for a customs check.

1g8l9w7.q: The sign shown is placed near a road works site
1g8l9w7.why: The yellow temporary sign is placed near a road works site (cantiere stradale).

1atncn3.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the compulsory direction for road trains and articulated lorries
1atncn3.why: The yellow sign gives advance notice of the compulsory direction, straight ahead, for road trains and articulated lorries.

1ferdl2.q: The sign shown is installed for the duration of the road works
1ferdl2.why: The yellow background marks a temporary sign, installed only while the roadworks last.

eta2ei.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of the direction to a refuelling and parking area for heavy vehicles
eta2ei.why: The sign shows the compulsory direction at the roadworks. It is not about a refuelling area.

1u9e6hy.q: The sign shown requires all vehicles to continue straight ahead
1u9e6hy.why: The sign applies only to the heavy vehicles shown on it, not to all vehicles.

19wzopd.q: The sign shown gives advance notice of a recommended direction
19wzopd.why: The sign announces a compulsory direction, not a recommended one.

ugyyle.q: The sign shown advises all vehicles to follow the direction indicated by the arrow
ugyyle.why: The sign makes the direction compulsory, not advisory, and it applies only to the heavy vehicles shown.
